def: properly, to be slack, i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish

words.word: upon us wherein we have done foolishly

occurrences.text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
words: upon us wherein we have done foolishly

occurrences.text: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the Lord, nor the judgment of their God.
A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
